notes:
Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (2026-09-12, fin/83, {1}{U} Legendary Creature — Octopus). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed): "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it. (reminder text) / Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least eight mana was spent to cast it, put eight +1/+1 counters on Ultros."

Mana-spent tracking: checked Sahagin (fin/71, same batch, identical real `ValidSA$ Spell.ManaSpent GE4` condition) before writing this card's own model — its definition.ts comment concludes this engine has no mana-spent tracking anywhere (no Effect/EffectContext field carries how much mana a cast spent). Kept consistent: this card's own two named triggers (`onNoncreatureSpellCastGE4Mana`/`onNoncreatureSpellCastGE8Mana`) already stood on that same convention before this task (a scenario firing the named trigger stands in for the condition being met) — unchanged, just cross-checked and cited in the comment.

6 facts total (5 SOURCE + 1 SINK), all annotated (card added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS in scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs; weights via compute-weights.mjs --slug=ultros-obnoxious-octopus).

Baseline: self-cast ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', controller:'you', subject:'self', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Creature') and self-enters ({event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', subject:'self', target:'self'}, same anchor) — the pre-existing bare `{zone:'Battlefield', subject:'self'}`/`{zone:'Graveyard', subject:'self'}` presence facts (old v1 schema) are both gone: the Battlefield one is superseded by the real self-enters MOVEMENT fact (SOURCE facts must describe a movement, never bare presence, per SYNERGY_DESIGN.md); the Graveyard one had no real basis at all (Ultros's own oracle text never puts it in a graveyard) and was dropped outright rather than carried forward, per the same 'fold it or drop it, don't force-annotate a fact with nothing real to anchor to' rule Summon: Bahamut's own self-battlefield fact removal already established.

The two independent mana-spent thresholds (4 and 8) are modeled as 2 separate real-effect fact groups, not folded together (they're independent triggers with genuinely different effects, not a modal choice):
- GE4 (tap+stun): 2 SOURCE facts, `{event:'tap', controller:'opp', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true}` and `{event:'putCounter', counterType:'stun', controller:'opp', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true}`, reusing Ice Flan's own real fact shape precedent (narrowed to `has:['Creature']` only, not Ice Flan's `hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']`, since this card's real oracle text says 'target creature an opponent controls' — no artifact disjunction, and no engine-narrowing gap either, unlike Ice Flan's own documented mismatch). Paired with 1 SINK fact reusing the same Ice Flan precedent: `{to:'Battlefield', controller:'opp', types:{has:['Creature']}}` (wants a legal target to exist).
- GE8 (self +1/+1 x8): 1 SOURCE fact, `{event:'putCounter', counterType:'+1/+1', target:'self'}` (no `targeted`, no sink — self-only, no external want).

Real engine fix found and corrected while modeling this (not just a fact-authoring task): definition.ts's own GE4 effect used to be a `kind:'custom'` hand-rolled workaround (predating `tapTarget`/`putCounterTarget`'s own `owner` field) that called `actions.putCounter(target, 'Stun', 1)` — capital 'Stun', inconsistent with the pool-wide lowercase 'stun' convention (Ice Flan, Tonberry, Summon Shiva, Aerith Rescue Mission all use lowercase; only this card and Omega, Heartless Evolution used capital). Replaced with 2 declarative effects (`tapTarget`+`putCounterTarget`, both `validType:'creature', owner:'opponents'`), matching Ice Flan's own current (post-`owner`-field) pattern — Ice Flan's own definition.ts comment explicitly calls this exact card out by name as one of the 'now-obsolete custom workarounds used before owner existed on these kinds'. This also fixed the counterType casing bug for free (lowercase 'stun' throughout now), which the first verify-synergy.mjs pass caught as a real hard failure (produce fact had no supporting trace line — the logged trace said 'Stun', the fact said 'stun').

Scenarios consolidated from 3 to 2 (plus keywordScenarios' own auto-added legend-rule scenario): the 2 old `trigger:`-scoped scenarios that separately fired GE4-with-target and GE8 are now ONE scenario (`sequence: ['onNoncreatureSpellCastGE4Mana', 'onNoncreatureSpellCastGE8Mana']`, no top-level `trigger`) — realistically, a single noncreature spell that spends 8+ mana also spent 4+, so casting ONE big spell fires both real triggers at once, matching the task's own 'not branching in the modal sense' framing. This also fixed a real evidence gap: the old `trigger:`-scoped scenarios started self already on the battlefield (harness.ts's own `selfZone` rule), so the new baseline self-cast/self-enters facts would have had ZERO real trace evidence; dropping the top-level `trigger` and using `sequence` instead runs the real cast->enters lifecycle FIRST (same ice-flan/dwarven-castle-guard/cloudbound-moogle consolidation precedent), giving both baseline facts real `fn:'cast'`/`fn:'enters'` trace lines. The 'no legal target' edge case (real branch in the tapTarget/putCounterTarget pool-emptiness check, distinct from the threshold non-branching) stays as its own second scenario.

verify-synergy.mjs scoped (ultros-obnoxious-octopus): 0 hard failures (1 soft note: `legendRule` trace line with no matching declared produce — expected/structural for every Legendary creature run through keywordScenarios' own duplicateLegendaryEnters scenario; no fact vocabulary for the legend rule exists or is warranted). Full pool (319 checked): 3 pre-existing hard failures (al-bhed-salvagers, stuck-in-summoner-s-sanctum, valkyrie-aerial-unit), all unrelated to this card (other concurrent sessions' own in-flight work, per git status — sahagin's own definition.ts/scenarios.ts/synergy.json/trace.json/annotations-authoring.json were all mid-edit by another session during this task, confirmed via git status; this card's own trace.json was transiently clobbered back to its pre-task state mid-task by that concurrent activity and had to be regenerated a second time — final state re-verified clean after that). npx vitest run functional-model: 351/351 passed. find-synergies.mjs before/after (isolated via a real HEAD-vs-working-tree swap of just this card's own synergy.json, not a stale full-repo diff): before 163 lines (142 'battlefield presence' + 21 'graveyard presence', both from the old v1 bare-presence facts), after 142 (all 'enters the battlefield', from the new real self-enters movement fact) — net -21, fully accounted: the 142 battlefield-presence matches are the SAME cards, just correctly relabeled from a bare presence claim to a real movement fact (no matching regression); the 21 lost graveyard-presence matches are the deliberate, correct removal of the old bogus self-graveyard presence fact, which had no real textual basis at all (Ultros's own oracle text never sends it to a graveyard). Zero new matches from the newly-authored tap/putCounter(stun)/putCounter(+1/+1 x8)/opponent-creature-presence-sink facts — real, expected: no other pool card currently sources a `tap`/`putCounter:stun` event or wants one, same 'new, forward-looking vocabulary, 0 matches today' pattern already established for other newly-promoted event vocabulary (pump, addMana, etc).
knownGaps: No real mana-spent tracking anywhere in this engine (checked, consistent with Sahagin/fin-71's own identical conclusion) — both `onNoncreatureSpellCastGE4Mana`/`onNoncreatureSpellCastGE8Mana` real cast-time conditions ('if at least N mana was spent to cast it') are not actually evaluated; a scenario/trace firing the named trigger at all already stands in for the condition having been met.
oracleTextSnapshot:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least eight mana was spent to cast it, put eight +1/+1 counters on Ultros.
